analysis: All changes in this batch are documentation only: docs/reference/configuration.md (the visible tail covers the unchanged link-fix, link-setup-v2 and console sections), the new docs/reports/2026-10-31-public-cluster-models.md, and docs/reports/README.md. No executable code, keys, attestation logic or wire formats change in the supplied evidence, so there is no regression in the A-001, A-003, A-015, A-016, A-017 or TB-011 controls. The new report is an owner-decision record that declares GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B for public cluster traffic (pipeline and tensor parallel) and says releases will carry pair-serving grants and parity qualifications. That claims a policy change: pair members would be held to the grant rather than to the single-Mac requirements (mlx_nax, glm5_next_v1). The implementing code (ClusterPublicModels.swift, ClusterPairServingGrants, release cluster_runtime facts, coordinator cluster_pair_serving_grant.go) is not in the supplied units, so I could not verify the grant, evidence-hash binding or qualification checks. The report itself states the evidence limits: no pipeline run on two M5 Ultras, GLM tensor parallel resting on the owner's decision and DevNet results rather than a bundled qualification record, and grants issued despite members reporting only hardware capabilities. Still needing review: (1) that pair-serving grants cannot be self-asserted by a provider or untrusted release input and are bound to artifact hashes and the evidence SHA-256; (2) that the grant does not bypass T-054 and T-052 build qualification and serving-authorization (App Attest) checks; (3) that the T-056 overclaim limits (attestation is not correct computation) remain stated for public cluster traffic, and that the cluster hop keeps prompt sealing for A-001 in pair mode. These are unverified contracts, not findings. The configuration.md patch excerpt was truncated, so the changed 'Cluster runtime facts' text beyond that point was not fully seen; it is documentation of release-registered cluster_runtime facts.
